notes.title: Back to School Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow beastie adventurers!

This is a quick message to inform you about this September's update.

It includes:

[list]
[*] Improved music and sound effects
[*] Fixed minor bugs
[*] Polished controls and moving platforms
[/list]

See you inside! Don't get caught by the evil spirits!
